usage: llm-modelbench sensitivity-plan [-h] [--run-prefix RUN_PREFIX]
                                       [--include-regex INCLUDE_REGEX]
                                       [--tasks TASKS]
                                       [--level {smoke,short,full}]
                                       [--ctx-values CTX_VALUES]
                                       [--num-predict-values NUM_PREDICT_VALUES]
                                       [--judge {single,panel,off}]
                                       [--fingerprint]
                                       [--needle-max-ctx NEEDLE_MAX_CTX]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --run-prefix RUN_PREFIX
  --include-regex INCLUDE_REGEX
  --tasks TASKS
  --level {smoke,short,full}
  --ctx-values CTX_VALUES
  --num-predict-values NUM_PREDICT_VALUES
  --judge {single,panel,off}
  --fingerprint
  --needle-max-ctx NEEDLE_MAX_CTX
                        operator cap for generated needle sensitivity runs;
                        defaults to 40960 when tasks include needle
